name: rot-dtd-commander
description: RoT DtD Commander, the creator kit: 131 Claude Code commands, 22 skills and 5 agents that carry their own DTD grammar, verdict vocabulary, laws and trust boundary, checked by rules C1 to C15 against the prose beside them. Creators for prompts and meta-prompts over eight schematics, and for skills, hooks, commands, subagents, plans, MCP servers, workflow files, tasks, filetypes and dorks, each auditing what it wrote in the foreground. The Adiutor is a Stop-hook doctor that checks every -dtd answer against the DOCTYPE that produced it, with the Commander-Adiutor monitor beside it; a plain install arms nothing. Armed, the AI_SLOP gate judges every answer, file, commit message, request body and subagent answer before it lands. The codebase growth family walks any codebase on a declared fifteen-verb ladder and names the release its findings amount to, and the version a release publishes is the one its own recognizer computes (1440 declarations, thirty Adiutor guards and eighteen checker controls, every claim measured in CI).
